blazers.pulse: Monday's 106-98 loss in Minnesota stung because Portland's offense went cold and nobody but Deni Avdija got going. Avdija's 27 points kept fans happy with him, but the free-throw gap and turnovers had people grumbling. Good news: the rematch is tonight, so there's a quick shot at revenge.
storylines: Lost 106-98 at Minnesota; Terrence Shannon Jr. dropped a career-high 34
Avdija: 27 points, 8 boards, 4 assists, but no other Blazer scored more than 10
Clingan put up 10 points, 10 rebounds and 5 blocks
Rematch at Minnesota tonight (Tue Nov 17); Morant, Krejci and Sharpe listed out, Youngblood iffy

timbers.pulse: The Timbers snuck into the playoffs as the West's No. 7 seed on a four-game win streak, and fans are leaning into the underdog role. Round One is a best-of-three against No. 2 FC Dallas, which hasn't lost to Portland in its last six meetings.
storylines: Game 1 at FC Dallas: Sat Nov 21, 1 p.m. Central (11 a.m. Pacific)
Game 2 at Providence Park: Sat Nov 28, 7:30 p.m.; also on FS1 and FOX Deportes, all games on Apple TV
Lassiter, Velde and Da Costa combined for 9 goals and 4 assists in the closing win streak
Third straight postseason, under Marti Cifuentes, who took over in July

f1.pulse: The titles are settled: Kimi Antonelli clinched the drivers' crown in Mexico and Mercedes wrapped up the constructors' in Sao Paulo. All the buzz now is the five-way scrap for runner-up heading into Las Vegas this week, the first Vegas race under the new no-DRS rules.
storylines: Las Vegas GP runs Nov 19-21; three races left
Fight for P2: Verstappen 279, Russell 262, Hamilton 261, Leclerc 249, Norris 246
Verstappen won Vegas in 2023 and 2025 and is the bookies' favorite
Lando Norris won from pole in Sao Paulo; Verstappen came from 21st to finish second

ducks.pulse: Saturday's 31-7 rout of Michigan at Autzen has Duck fans feeling great about the late-season turnaround. At 7-3 they're the highest-ranked three-loss team, and Dan Lanning is openly pitching their playoff case, though the remaining schedule offers no more ranked wins.
storylines: Beat Michigan 31-7; Dakorien Moore (59 yds) and Dierre Hill Jr. (49 yds) scored long TDs, Hill also ran for 98
No. 16 in the CFP rankings; still alive for an at-large spot or the Big Ten title route
Next game: Friday Nov 20 at Michigan State, 5:00 p.m. Pacific on FOX
Regular-season finale vs. Washington at Autzen on Nov 28 (time and TV TBA)

niners.pulse: Sunday's 46-40 shootout win in Dallas has the 49ers at 8-1 and No. 1 in the power rankings, with Purdy posting a career-best 389 passing yards. The worry is the defense: zero sacks and pressure on just 12 of 51 dropbacks, and Niners Nation is arguing over whether the pass rush or the secondary is the bigger problem.
storylines: Beat Dallas 46-40: 584 yards of offense, two long McCaffrey TD catches, a 70-yard Deebo TD run
Pass rush vs. secondary debate; Bosa still looking for his first sack since returning
Shanahan on the late fade: "It seems like we got gassed"
Next game: Sunday Nov 22 vs. Vikings in Mexico City, 5:20 p.m. Pacific on NBC/Peacock (Sunday Night Football)

sources.name: NBC Sports Bay Area (how to watch)
